comparison.objective: Disconnect an air hose and lock its plug in a pneumatic lockout; candidate tunes an isolated damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Coupler release, hose separation and plug enclosure versus fine tool engagement, collar rotation and force-limited setscrew locking.
comparison.success_condition: Hose disconnected and plug locked versus repeated controlled stops without overload, rebound or drift.
comparison.reason: The essential connector-release/lockout mechanism and terminal state differ from damper calibration. Detailed force and lock criteria are absent.
